text_block_list.text: Did you enjoy the race, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It looked like everyone in the stands was
having
fun too!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Their sparkling eyes and cheering voices
mean
more than anything to me!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
After all, I was only able to win today
because of
their support!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You know what? I want to do something
for them
as thanks!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
You've already gifted them with a fantastic
victory!
They're expecting great races from you yet.

text_block_list.text:

for them
as thanks!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
You've already gifted them with a fantastic
victory!
They're expecting great races from you yet.

text_block_list.text:
Haha! You flatter me. ♪ You say that as
if that's
the greatest gift of all.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: But thank you! That means a lot to me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The track is my stage, and I still have so
many
more races to perform on it!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Each time I step up on that stage, I'll
give
everyone the time of their
lives—and that's a
promise.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's time to make our triumphant return
together!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you to keep up the
tough love
в тренировке!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
